title: Punctation of Olmütz
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Punctation of Olmütz", at revision 1253755800, opens: "The Punctation of Olmütz, also called the Agreement of Olmütz, was a treaty between Prussia and Austria, dated 29 November 1850, by which Prussia abandoned the Erfurt Union and accepted the revival of the German Confederation under Austrian leadership. The treaty concluded the Autumn Crisis of 1850 in Germany." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q708601, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty between Austria and Prussia 1850". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
